notes: IRPEF brackets: three-bracket structure per L. 199/2025 (Legge di Bilancio 2026); second bracket reduced from 35% to 33% effective 2026-01-01.
work_deduction_breakpoints: Art. 13 co. 1 TUIR, as modified by D.Lgs. 216/2023 and confirmed by L. 207/2024.

INPS rates: credito sector (Credito e Assicurazioni). employee_rate 9.19% (IVS+NASpI). employer_rate 26.76% flat (no size tiers); source: kitech.it/Contributi-previdenziali.aspx?p=9_165 (proxy — SIMPLIFICATION: proxy data, verify against INPS circular). No size-tier pages for credito on kitech.it (industria has separate tier pages), corroborating flat structure. Fondo di solidarietà del credito (bilateral, substitutes FIS/CIGO/CIGS) is sector-specific and presumed included in the aggregate 26.76% — not double-counted (SIMPLIFICATION: verify against INPS circulars).
fixed_term_additional_rate: NASpI addizionale base rate 1.4% (employer-only) per Art. 2 co. 28 L. 92/2012.
INPS employee — employee_rate 9.19% flat (IVS+NASpI); the Fondo di solidarietà del credito employee share is presumed included in the aggregate (SIMPLIFICATION: verify against INPS circulars).

Apprentice contributions (L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773; L. 92/2012 art. 2 c. 36-37): employer 10% + NASpI 1.31% + 0.30% = 11.61%; employee 5.84%. Firms with at most 9 employees pay 1.5% (+1.61% NASpI) in months 0-11 and 3% (+1.61%) in months 12-23, then 11.61%. SIMPLIFICATION: hiring incentives (sgravi) and Cassa Edile apprentice schemes are not modelled.
